_comment: Proposed by F4b (foundation owner) 2026-10-15 for the orchestrator; NOT added to migration/parity-exemptions.json. Format: parity-exemptions.json `rules`. Derived from migration/screens/Photobook/parity/default.json after the F4b changes (345 differences, all covered: layout 230, position 69, style 46). Replaces the earlier PHOTOBOOK-MASKED-PHOTOS-LAYOUT scope entry. Dropped PHOTOBOOK-OPTIONS-INACTIVITY-TIMER: with the capture-plan settle of 5500 ms the options are hidden in the build too (no class, structure or visibility differences left in state default).

rules.reason: Household photos are person data: the capture masks every Photobook_Item background image (data-masked-src="user-image", src=""), so the replayed reference's empty img is 27 px high and DIV_BackgroundImage, the UBT_LazyImage chain and the img are 410×27; the build shows the neutral placeholder (Q-W2C-1) at 410×273. 10 elements × 23 slides.
rules.evidence: migration/screens/Photobook/analysis/dom/default.html:98 (DIV_BackgroundImage of slide 0), :107 (img data-masked-src="user-image", src="", data-rendered-size 390x259 on TST; same on every slide), :117 (DIV_ForegroundImage), :144 (Title_Background, name masked as bullets); migration/screens/Photobook/parity/default.json (2026-10-15T12:37, after the F4b changes)

rules.reason: Same masked background photo: the vertically centred DIV_BackgroundImage moves with its 27 px vs 273 px height (offset y -1 → -6). One per slide.

rules.reason: Same masked background photo: the computed bottom of the absolutely positioned DIV_BackgroundImage follows its height (818px for 27 px, 584px for 273 px). Only `bottom` is exempted.

rules.reason: Masked foreground photo (inside PanZoom): the empty img has no width, so the shrink-to-fit DIV_ForegroundImage is 0 px wide and centred (computed left/right 195px); with the build's placeholder image it fills the slide (0px). Only `left` and `right` are exempted.

rules.reason: The household name in Title_FamilyName is masked in the capture (bullets, e.g. dom/default.html Title_Background of slide 0), the mock has fictional names of the same word lengths; the centred Title_Background moves horizontally with the text width (only x differs). The parity tool skips elements whose own text is masked, not their centred ancestors.

rules.reason: The thumbnail list is scrolled by 16 px at runtime: the List's componentdidmount runs ScrollSelectedIntoPosition(IsInstantScroll True), scrollAmount = SelectedItemPosition (SelectedPosition + 1 = 1) × 40 (32 px item + 8 px margin-right) − (8/2 + 40/2) = 16, which centres the first thumbnail (list padding = half the width). The reference is rebuilt from the captured HTML, which cannot carry an element's scrollLeft, so it always shows scroll 0: every thumbnail sits exactly 16 px further right. Capture artifact; the build follows the compiled JS (same selector and formula).
rules.evidence: migration/screens/Photobook/analysis/sources/pretty/UBTConnect.Directory_Photobook.Photobook_Gallery.mvc.js:247-252 (componentdidmount), :578-589 (ScrollIntoPosition parameters; :587 SelectedItemPosition = SelectedPosition + 1), :703-727 (ScrollIntoPositionJS); .claude/skills/outsystems-screen-spec/scripts/parity_check.cjs:612-626 (reference rebuilt from dom/default.html by buildDom) and :395-397 (offsets from getBoundingClientRect, which includes the parent's scroll); app/src/screens/Photobook/components/Photobook_Gallery.tsx scrollIntoPosition
